contract: The supported Spokeo adapter is consumed through explicit console and discoverable native-provider operations for scan, prepare, approved submit and verify. Every action targets an existing consented durable case at an exact revision. Preparation submits nothing and returns disabled, contract-only or live readiness explicitly. Submission requires a per-request approval checkbox/constant, native tool approval, the exact approval phrase and, outside a contract server, the disabled-by-default runtime live-submit gate. Verification confirms removal only from a later negative provider rescan. The supported Whitepages continuation prepares a fixed-recipient removal/deletion email only through the canonical account-bound outbound-email record, requires exact digest approval and separate dispatch confirmation, retains SMTP acceptance separately from uncertain delivery, and correlates only already-ingested replies. Manual verification codes must match canonical reply content; links remain unopened and neither reply nor SMTP acceptance proves removal.
